title: Jay-Z Ends His Tour With Surprise Guests in Los Angeles
summary:
Jay-Z ended his tour with a night full of surprises. At his second concert at Los Angeles' SoFi Stadium, the last show of the Jay-Z 30 Tour, he brought out Snoop Dogg, Dr. Dre, and Too Short.

Too Short came on first, singing his 2006 hit Blow the Whistle, with Jay-Z adding his Playoff freestyle. Later, Jay-Z sang his own song D'Evils over the beat of a Snoop Dogg song, and Snoop Dogg came onstage. Then Dr. Dre joined them for a medley of The Next Episode, California Love, Nothin' But a 'G' Thang, and Still D.R.E.

Before the show, there were unconfirmed reports on social media that ticket prices for Saturday's show had fallen, with some tickets even given away for free. During Encore, Jay-Z spoke about the rumours and about artificial intelligence. He told the crowd to trust what they could see and hear for themselves, and to question everything they feel, especially in a world where technology can trick people.

The night before, he had brought out his daughter Blue Ivy, Scarface, DJ Khaled, and John Legend.
why_it_matters: It shows why it helps to check what you see and hear for yourself instead of believing every rumour you hear.
